lineage.strategy: Acquire a materially different current commercial deployment source rather than repeat prior generic platform evidence.

observations.fact: Mobileye said select Stellantis vehicles expected in 2027 will integrate its Cloud-Enhanced ADAS using REM; it also said five of the ten largest automakers contribute data to REM, which drew from more than 8 million vehicles covering 34 billion miles in the prior year.

risks.risk: The announcement does not disclose program revenue, unit economics, take rate or margin contribution.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental economics and production volume attributable to the Stellantis REM program remain undisclosed.

recommendation: Use as source-addressed commercial-adoption and data-network evidence; Alpha must source any numeric economics separately.
